# agnostic-ai home

> A global configuration for AI coding agents, kept in one git clone linked to `~/.agnostic-ai`. `agnostic-ai sync --global` writes it to Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor (and any other supported tool listed in `local/targets`) in each tool's native format. Personal changes live in the gitignored `local/` layer, so the clone stays pristine and `git pull` never conflicts.

This repo is a working example of an agnostic-ai global home: working agreements, skills, read-only agents, and a shell guard hook, with per-tool values where tools differ.

To install for a user, clone https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home and follow SETUP.md in order. Never edit tracked files; put user changes in `local/`.

## Start here

- [SETUP.md](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/blob/main/SETUP.md): the agent procedure. Install agnostic-ai, clone and link, detect tools, resolve collisions, sync, verify, extend with `local/`, update.
- [README.md](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/blob/main/README.md): what ships and the manual quick start.
- [sync.sh](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/blob/main/sync.sh): runs `agnostic-ai sync --global --only <targets>`, reading targets from `local/targets` (default `claude,codex,cursor`). As a git pre-commit hook it runs `--check`.

## Specs

- [AGNOSTIC_AI.md](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/blob/main/AGNOSTIC_AI.md): the working agreements, emitted as each tool's global instructions file.
- [skills/](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/tree/main/skills): `gh-issue`, `gh-issues` (manual), `pr-value-audit` (manual), `object-design`, `recovery-evidence`, `agnostic-ai-specs`, `i-have-adhd` (manual). Manual skills set `disable-model-invocation: true` and `x-codex.policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false`.
- [agents/](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/tree/main/agents): `locator`, `claim-verifier`, `reviewer`. All `readonly: true`, with per-target `model` and `effort` maps.
- [hooks/](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/tree/main/hooks): `guard-shell.yaml` (`PreToolUse`, claude and codex) and `guard-shell-cursor.yaml` (`beforeShellExecution`, cursor). Sync does not translate event names, so each tool gets its own spec.
- [scripts/guard-shell.py](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai-home/blob/main/scripts/guard-shell.py): the hook. Exit 2 with a reason on stderr for Claude and Codex; a `{"permission": ...}` JSON reply for Cursor.

## Local layer

- `local/targets`: comma-separated agnostic-ai target names to sync.
- `local/AGNOSTIC_AI.md`: appended after the shared agreements.
- `local/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `local/agents/<name>.md`, `local/hooks/<name>.yaml`: a same-name file replaces the shared spec whole; a new name is added.
- Switch a shared spec off by copying it into `local/` with `targets-exclude: [<every synced target>]`.
- `agnostic-ai list --global` shows each spec's layer (`global` or `global-local`).

## agnostic-ai

- [agnostic-ai llms.txt](https://agnostic-ai.org/llms.txt): the tool's own index.
- [Spec format](https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/spec-format/): frontmatter fields, per-target maps, `x-<target>` blocks, target scoping.
- [Global configuration](https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/configuration/#global-configuration): `--global`, the `local/` layer, collisions, ownership state.
- [Targets](https://agnostic-ai.org/docs/targets/): every tool's paths and capabilities.
